thread:
AcmeSupport: Hi team — customer AcmeFinance says they've been trying to delete workspace data (DELETE /v1/retention/objects?workspace_id=acme-123) and are getting HTTP 500 with body 'deletion_blocked_by_kms_hold'. They reported the data was scheduled for deletion 2026-02-28 but it's still present. Audit UI shows retention_policy=custom, retention_expires=2026-03-05. Ticket #8342. Response included trace=tr-8b4f2. Can we confirm why delete is blocked and provide an ETA for purge?
Jordan (Support): Thanks — escalating to security + ops. Quick questions: are they on Private or Hosted? Can you paste the exact curl/response body? If we need immediate mitigation, say so.
AcmeSupport: They're on Hosted (api.redwood.ai). Here's the response body they pasted: `{\n  "error": "deletion_blocked_by_kms_hold",\n  "trace": "tr-8b4f2",\n  "message": "object protected by KMS/HSM legal hold"\n}` and curl: `curl -X DELETE \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/retention/objects?workspace_id=acme-123\" -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED'`
Rahul (Ops): I'm seeing a matching 500 in deletion-service logs at 2026-03-01T14:03:22Z for tr-8b4f2. Error path is kms-client -> unlock -> HoldDetected. It looks like our legal-hold service has an active hold token for that workspace. Pulling hold metadata now.
Olivia (SRE): Also observed a short spike of 500s around 03:20 UTC for the delete endpoint; stack trace points to KMS client returning locked state, not a transient network error.
Nate (Eng): If retention_expires is 2026-03-05 but a hold is set, the hold should override deletion. We need to know who/what created the hold and whether it was via our UI or an API call.
Emily (Legal): I can confirm a legal hold was entered on 2026-03-01 for acme-123 tied to a preservation request. We need documentation (subpoena/preservation order) to remove the hold. Without court clearance we cannot authorize deletion.
AcmeSupport: Customer insists they never requested a hold. They're asking for audit log evidence (who created the hold, IP, timestamp) and a signed HSM/KMS proof if possible. They're escalating to their legal team.
Jordan (Support): Understood. Rahul — can you pull the audit log slice (authentication actor, api_key/id, source IP, user-agent, request id) and obfuscate any secrets before we send to customer? Also propose a goodwill credit for storage while this is disputed.
Rahul (Ops): Pulled logs: hold creation entry -> actor: `acme-legal@acme.com`, method: POST /v1/holds, api_key: ak-XXXX, timestamp: 2026-03-01T14:03:22Z, ip: 198.51.100.22, control_plane: private-deploy-1. Attaching redacted extract to ticket.
AcmeSupport: Forwarded extract to AcmeFinance. They requested the KMS key id and HSM signature metadata.
Olivia (SRE): From a mitigation standpoint we can snapshot and tag the workspace as 'preserved-snapshot' so the rest of their workspace can be cleaned up while the held object remains. We cannot delete objects under hold. If hold is removed, manual purge path from ops takes ~24-48h to complete for the affected objects due to KMS unlock and multi-region garbage collection.
Nate (Eng): We'll also add a clearer error code and message in the deletion API so clients can see 'HTTP 423 HOLD' instead of opaque 500s. Short-term, include `error_code: KMS_HOLD_ACTIVE` in responses.
Jordan (Support): TL;DR and action items: 1) Send audit log extract to customer (Rahul) — DONE. 2) Legal to confirm hold origin and removal requirements (Emily). 3) Ops to estimate manual purge timeline if hold removed (Rahul/Olivia) — ETA 24-48h after removal. 4) Product to approve a small storage credit for disputed days (asking). 5) Eng to improve error code/message (Nate). I'll update ticket #8342 and keep customer in the loop. :thumbsup:
Incident Bot: Escalation created INC-2026-00317 and assigned to ops, legal, eng.
AcmeSupport: Customer acknowledged receipt of audit extract and is reviewing internally. They asked for daily status updates until resolved. We'll keep updates concise here.
Jordan (Support): I'll post a final summary once Legal confirms whether a court order exists or we have authorization to remove the hold. If customer provides an order, Ops will execute the purge and confirm GC completion trace ids.
Rahul (Ops): Noted — prepping GC playbook and collecting KMS key IDs and HSM audit logs for handoff.
Nate (Eng): Filing a follow-up ticket to change response code and include hold metadata in API errors so this is less ambiguous for customers.
Emily (Legal): If Acme provides a written request + identity verification and there's no active subpoena, we can start hold removal workflow. Otherwise, hold stands.
AcmeSupport: Thanks all — customer wanted to emphasize urgency but understands legal constraints. They'll update us after their internal legal check.
